name: Mizutoki Makino
source:
Daughter of Masashi. She is quiet and does not reveal her emotions much. 

She is sexually curious, she is attracted to Katsutoshi, a wild and dominant man whom she keeps a secret from her father, and she begins to develop her own sexuality.

"...Y-Yes. I did as you told me, mister... I came so many times..."

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt279/apt279.html#link_character]official site[/url]]
